photoSelectionSummary.countingPolicy: Original photographs, photographic collages, and video frames are separately identified. exactOrSeriesPhotoCount keeps the prior still-image convention but excludes video frames; exactOrSeriesOriginalPhotoCount excludes the collage too. Same-shot resolution upgrades and mapping upgrades do not add distinct images.
photoSelectionSummary.researchScope: Only genuinely new avenues in the pass05 ledgers were checked. The prior complete pass04 family audit is carried forward; no fresh all-family or Internet-exhaustion claim.
photoSelectionSummary.photoRoleCountingNote: Nameplate/details and transport-state photographs retain their roles. Multiple matching photos do not necessarily mean multiple complete-unit angles.
